text: An old man lies wounded by the roadside, clutching a worn jade token.

outcomes.text: He thanks you weakly and disappears into the night.

text: A grand procession arrives at your door. The old man you saved is an elder of the Heavenly Pavilion, and he remembers you.

choices.label: Accept his gift of spirit treasures

outcomes.text: He grants you a treasure trove, including a robe woven with spirit silk.
